pages.text: Bugs that hunt will not hunt anyone wearing gold. They never take offence at a gold wearer, and a chase ends the moment gold goes on.

$(item)Bound by the rule$()$(br)Golden silverfish$(br)Scorpions, of every colour$(br)Gold beetles$(br)Moths, of every variant, rare or not$(br)Bookyflies, of both kinds$(br2)Only aggression is covered. Gold does not break the gaze of the moths that hold it.
$(item)Gold kinds (1/3)$()$(br)$(item)Gold scorpion$(): holds a grudge, and alone takes pottery sherds into its sting.$(br2)$(item)Gold locust$(): strips any mature crop for 32 blocks around.
$(item)Gold kinds (2/3)$()$(br)$(item)Gold beetle$(): the only beetle that fights, and may carry a potion gene.$(br2)$(item)Gold moth$(): holds your gaze, like the rare moths.
$(item)Gold kinds (3/3)$()$(br)$(item)Gold bookskito$(): shimmers like an enchanted book, and learns the enchantments it is fed.
